title: The Service Advisor role has no status, tracking or delete controls
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Make sure the Service Advisor role is at its default permissions: reset it to its template, so earlier edits do not change the result.
  • Sign in as a staff member with the default Service Advisor role at the test location.
  • Have an active, tracked part, part A, with 2 on hand.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  2. Press Escape.
  3. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  4. Click the part A row.
  5. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu lists Cycle count and Export, with no Deactivate parts entry.

Step 2:

  • The menu closes.

Step 3:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 4:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.
  • No Delete Part button shows in the footer (only Cancel and Save).
  • Part Status and the Track quantities and cost of goods switch are greyed out: the controls are missing or disabled exactly where Delete Part is missing.

Step 5:

  • The window closes without saving.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions)

  • S8-R14: “The controls this spec gates on the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission show to exactly the users who see Delete on the part dialog today. By default those are Admin, Service Manager and Parts Manager.”
  • Key Decisions: “Access does not change. Retiring a part, bringing it back and changing its tracking use the same access ShopView applies to deleting an inventory part today. The controls show to exactly the users who see Delete on the part dialog today. The system accepts exactly the users it accepts a delete from today, on every route. No user gains or loses access on release day (Story 8).”
  • S8-R12: “Delete Part in the part dialog requires the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission. Without it the button is not shown.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
